text: Integrated affine-plus-small-strain fitting through the same cached projected-patch curvature/RHS, shared data-plus-field-prior operator, shared physical displacement metric, Gale PCG adapter, pose-eliminated Schur system, nonnegative loss-only early rejection, undamped prediction and fixed selection checkpoints used by PE fitting. Every proposal passes the small-strain certificate. Added an explicit data-only field diagonal gate before prior/damping; prior-dominated fits return the validated base and cannot count as nonlinear success. Results separate data/prior/selection objectives, field data-only evidence, rank, certificate and phase work. Independent generated-warp tests pass the <0.1 mm landmark RMS and <0.01 mm inverse roundtrip starting gates, exercise three deterministic noise seeds and three increasing omitted-mode amplitudes as error distributions, return PriorDominated with zero trial work for gradient-degenerate data, and return UnsafeGeometry for an over-limit trial while retaining the affine base. Existing PE optimizer and public linear Flashalign API suites remain unchanged; Flashalign production contains no HalfFlow dependency. Gates: JVM PE/anatomical/API 14/14; Scala.js 14/14; strict Werror; git diff --check clean. These are analytic implementation gates, not anatomical validation or runtime qualification.
